properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency of the pool framework-solve solve scripts (hash.js is in their yarn.lock resolution). The build ships SHA-1/SHA-2 family hashing whether or not a solve script calls it directly; typical use is ETag/cache-key or digest in the CTF solve tooling, not a security control.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The sha1 0.6.0 crate is resolved in the bugchain setup program's dependency tree (Cargo.lock). It ships SHA-1 hashing in the built binary; SHA-1 is collision-broken, so any security use (signature/cert digest) would be invalid — here it is toolchain surface, likely transitive.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live CI deploy step in the neodyme-breakpoint-workshop repo: builds mdbook docs and rsyncs them to a production server (workshop.neodyme.io under caddy) with SSH host-key verification disabled. Any MITM between the runner and the server can tamper with the deployed content or capture the session; the tunnel authenticates nothing about the host. Changeable here: switch to a known_hosts pin or CI-side host-key variable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring 0.16.20 is resolved in both lockfiles (bugchain flag-program Rust crate; pool framework-solve JS toolchain). ring ships X25519 ECDH (plus ECDSA P-256 and Ed25519) — TLS key-agreement surface the build carries; harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure applies only where an actual session is negotiated. Two sites, both lockfile declarations of the same library version.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic 6.5.4 is resolved in the pool framework-solve yarn.lock. It provides ECDSA signing/verification (secp256k1 by default) to the CTF solve tooling; the build ships the algorithm whether or not a solve script invokes it directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic 6.5.4 also provides ECDH key agreement (secp256k1 default curve) in the same framework-solve dependency tree. Same resolved library as the ECDSA entry (ALG-710f61f0) but a distinct primitive with a different migration path (ML-KEM vs ML-DSA), so kept as its own algorithm view.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl 1.0.3 is resolved in the framework-solve yarn.lock and provides XSalsa20-Poly1305 secretbox/box (symmetric AE — not Shor-relevant, hence the A+ rating). It is the signing layer under the Solana JS tooling in this repo family.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The openssl 0.10.38 crate is resolved in the bugchain setup crate (Cargo.lock). It binds the system OpenSSL, whose version (not pinned here) decides post-quantum capability — 0.10.x predates any PQ awareness. Changeable here: what the setup binary links and negotiates.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: native-tls 0.2.8 is resolved in the bugchain setup crate; it delegates TLS to the platform OpenSSL and its cipher/group defaults, which contain no PQ groups. The setup program opens the TLS session this asset configures.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 JS library (Ed25519, X25519, XSalsa20-Poly1305) resolved for the framework-solve scripts; same resolved package as the XSalsa20-Poly1305 algorithm entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: openssl@0.10.38 crate resolved in the bugchain setup Cargo.lock; same resolved package as the OpenSSL-primitives algorithm entry ALG-09fdf35b.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha1@0.6.0 crate resolved in the bugchain setup Cargo.lock; same resolved package as the SHA-1 algorithm entry ALG-725ecd3e.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 resolved in the framework-solve yarn.lock — the JS library providing ECDSA/ECDH (secp256k1 default curve) to the pool solve tooling. The per-primitive entries for it are ALG-710f61f0 (ECDSA) and ALG-c9ffc8a8 (ECDH); this object is the library-level view of the same resolved package.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hmac@0.8.1 resolved in the bugchain flag-program Cargo.lock. HMAC (symmetric MAC, quantum-resilient at 256-bit key sizes) ships in the deployed on-chain program's build. This object is in flag-program which is otherwise scout 1's shard area, but the hmac library object was assigned to this shard; the flag-program algorithm-level objects (HMAC ALG-0db1f0bc etc.) are scout 1's to judge.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: native-tls@0.2.8 resolved in the bugchain setup Cargo.lock; same resolved package as the platform-TLS algorithm entry ALG-20e70c39. The version predates PQ awareness — TLS sessions it opens negotiate classical groups only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 resolved in the framework-solve yarn.lock; same resolved package as the SHA-family algorithm entry ALG-50e53f84. Provides SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 (and RIPEMD-160) hashing primitives to the solve tooling.
